content: उखः A boiler, pot, vessel. चरुं पञ्चबिलमुखं धर्मोऽभीन्धे <ls>Av. 11. 3. 18</ls>. .{@-खा@} .²1 A boiling vessel, a boiler or cooking pot (such as a sauce-pan; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>शेगडी</ns>). अन्यो ह्यग्निरुखाप्यन्या नित्यमेवमवेहि भोः <ls>Mb. 12. 315. 15</ls>. .²2 A fireplace at a sacrifice. .²3 A part of the body.
